$comment: Hard stops enforced by the runner. Any breach aborts the stage immediately and writes an ABORTED report.
$readLimitNote: About 1.5x each stage's planned estimate (node cli.mjs plan). Re-check after changing workload.json.

syntheticGeoSandbox.$comment: Synthetic gigs and users are placed here (Metro Manila box). In 'staging' set a box with no real dev testers nearby, because onOpenGigPosted pushes to available users within 10 km.

$latencyAbortNote: User decision 2026-11-23: on the emulator, latency reflects one local JVM (saturates ~50-60 concurrent sessions), so it never aborts a run there. Error-rate, read/write and run-time stops still apply. Billable environments keep abortOnP95LatencyMs.
